statement.zh: Casal《Fouilles d’Amri》(1964) 正式报告阿姆里层位序列，巩固印度河河谷前/早期哈拉帕研究基础。
statement.en: Casal’s Fouilles d’Amri (1964) formally reports the Amri stratified sequence, consolidating pre-/Early Harappan research in the Indus valley.
